name: Block Drop
blurb: Seven shapes. One well. Stack, rotate and clear lines before the clock runs out.

landing.pitch: Find the gap. Make the line.
landing.about: A falling-block puzzle with a separate well for every player. Seven-piece bags, ghost pieces, wall kicks and line-clear scoring. Play with a friend or a bot in two-minute rounds.
howToPlay: Move and rotate each falling shape into a gap.
Fill a horizontal row to clear it. Clear four at once for the biggest score.
Use the ghost outline to aim a hard drop. Keep your stack below the top.

controls.phone: Tap the arrows to move, ↻ to rotate and DROP to place the piece.
controls.computer: Left/right to move, up to rotate, down for soft drop and space for hard drop.
controls.tv: Watch every well; each player uses their own phone.
